input.rationale: Damage to the claimant's own kitchen property (charred cabinets, smoke damage to ceiling and walls) caused by an accidental grease fire, with no other party involved.

Fire damage to kitchen cabinets and smoke damage across multiple surfaces suggests moderate repair/replacement costs, though damage is localized to the kitchen, no injuries occurred, and the claimant successfully contained the fire.

input.claim_summary: Claim filed by Alex Doe (POL-1001) for kitchen fire damage. Active homeowners policy covers property damage with $500 deductible and $250,000 limit. Incident: grease flare-up on stove yesterday evening. Claimant extinguished fire with fire extinguisher. Damage: charred cabinets above stove, smoke damage to ceiling and walls. No injuries. Localized damage, medium severity.
